# LogoAI

> LogoAI is an AI-powered platform for designing custom logos and brand identities with millions of customizable templates and instant exports.

LogoAI provides an intuitive AI Logo Maker tool that generates professional logos in seconds, offering extensive customization options and export formats. The platform serves businesses and individuals seeking quick, affordable brand identity solutions with access to 6.8M+ design templates.

## Key Topics

- AI logo generator

- Logo design

- AI-generated logos
- Branding

- PDF export
- Brand Center
- Logo examples

## Core Tools & Features

- [AI Logo Maker](https://www.logoai.com/logo-maker): Main AI Logo Maker tool for generating custom logos with exports in multiple formats
- [Logo Design Templates & Ideas](https://www.logoai.com/logo): Logo templates and design ideas library with 6.8M+ customizable options for instant inspiration
- [Home](https://www.logoai.com): LogoAI homepage for AI-powered logo and brand identity design

## Pricing & Plans

- [Pricing & Coupon Codes](https://www.logoai.com/pricing): LogoAI pricing, plans, and official coupon codes for logo design discounts
